source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check version of BMC/BIOS from BIOS
2. Send command to check version of BMC : ipmitool raw 0x30 0x20

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Command should be sent successfully
2. Versions should be shown correctly before and after flashing.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the FirmwareInventory entry matching HIB/CPLD. No RISK.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; assumes a collection shape and accepts a broad HIB-or-CPLD name match that can select the wrong component and does not define the canonical version field.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / IMPROVED; correctly requires exact identity, full JSON and safe access, but treats the contradictory Master procedure as resolvable by inputs alone.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 740/2291 accepts the same regex-oriented command and does not resolve the HIB-CPLD versus BMC/BIOS target mismatch.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Its FULLY AUTOMATABLE conclusion is non-counting history and assumes a new component-bound procedure before engineering approves replacing the source core operation.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves source, ED-36 distinguishes missing inputs from target/core-operation conflicts, ED-38 reserves verdict ownership and ED-39 prohibits automatic component substitution.

original_test_intent: The Items request the HIB-CPLD firmware version before and after a separate approved flash, but the Master Procedure only observes BMC/BIOS and sends a BMC-version raw command.
original_method: The preserved steps use BIOS observation and raw `0x30 0x20` for BMC, while DeepSeek replaces them with a generic Redfish regex match. No source step identifies the HIB-CPLD or its version property.
manual_activity: Engineering must resolve whether this record validates HIB-CPLD or the copied BMC/BIOS path and approve a component-specific read contract before an operator or agent can produce acceptance evidence.
required_inputs: engineer decision on HIB-CPLD versus BMC/BIOS purpose
exact HIB-CPLD instance, location and firmware identifier
supported read-only inventory member and version property
approved before/after expected versions and flash reference
trusted Redfish authentication and certificate policy
safety_requirements: Do not issue UpdateService writes, upload images, reset components or execute undocumented raw commands in this version-check review.
Do not accept a broad `HIB|CPLD` regex, HTTP success or component name as firmware-version proof.
Reject `curl -k` and logged basic credentials; require trusted TLS and approved secret injection.
Preserve every inventory member and the exact selected resource after engineering approves the mapping.
Do not retry, guess among multiple matches or change platform state when identity/version evidence is ambiguous.
agent_execution_scope: No execution while the target/core-operation conflict is unresolved.
After approval, discover the advertised inventory, select the exact HIB-CPLD member by stable identity and compare its canonical version before and after.
Collect health and audit evidence and leave the final verdict to engineering.
engineer_actions: Decide whether the authoritative target is HIB-CPLD and approve the matching version-read semantics.
Approve exact component identity, version property, expected matrix and coverage equivalence of any Project Override.
Review complete evidence and issue the final PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command assumes a non-discovered JSON shape, disables certificate verification and may match unrelated HIB or CPLD entries; a returned member is not proof that its firmware version matches.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: None until engineering resolves the target. Then use trusted service discovery, exact stable member identity and a documented version property while preserving full responses.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: HIB-CPLD Items, copied BMC/BIOS procedure, raw `0x30 0x20`, Criteria, script and 5/0-minute values remain unchanged source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: If HIB-CPLD is confirmed, bind a stable inventory resource to the exact HIB-CPLD instance, retrieve its documented firmware-version property read-only and compare full before/after evidence with the approved release matrix.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the platform and HIB-CPLD instance approved by engineering.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, Redfish schema, HIB-CPLD, client and decoder revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform HIB-CPLD inventory and vendor firmware-version schema.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing HIB-CPLD-specific version read only as a recommendation while preserving the copied BMC/BIOS source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A regex-selected member or another CPLD cannot satisfy the HIB-CPLD checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Engineer target decision, exact resource/property and expected versions.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Non-unique names and multiple CPLDs can cause false component selection; a property may describe package rather than active firmware.

project_override_considerations: After the engineer resolves the target, the project may use Redfish, IPMI or a vendor tool only when the output is bound to the same HIB-CPLD and canonical version. Record the original method, replacement reason, equivalent coverage and any unverified original path.
expected_evidence: engineer-approved purpose and exact HIB-CPLD identity/location
complete trusted inventory discovery and all member payloads
selected stable resource with canonical version/status fields
approved before/after comparison and flash/activation audit reference

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items require HIB-CPLD firmware version, while the Procedure is explicitly BMC/BIOS and provides no HIB-CPLD selector, location or version field. Generic Criteria cannot establish which component must match.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The current blocker is not just credentials or expected values: the preserved target and core operation contradict one another. Choosing a Redfish replacement and exact component changes the test semantics and requires an engineer decision before execution.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes YES to BLOCKED because an unsafe broad regex and assumed schema cannot establish HIB-CPLD identity or version.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its exact-mapping and evidence controls but changes confirmation-gated to BLOCKED until engineering resolves whether the copied BMC/BIOS procedure may be replaced.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Rejects FULLY AUTOMATABLE because software automation cannot itself authorize a new core test operation.

review_improvement: Makes exact HIB-CPLD identity mandatory and exposes the source-design decision instead of hiding it behind a broad Redfish filter.
independent_technical_reasoning: A supported Redfish or vendor inventory can make the eventual readback automatable, but this Master record has no HIB-CPLD operation at all. DeepSeek's regex may select any HIB or CPLD and the source raw command is identified as BMC version. Until engineering approves the intended target and component-bound read method, neither path can satisfy the title, so the static review is BLOCKED without making a DUT verdict.
